verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm Slack (draft/send Slack messages via Chat), Notion-adjacent workflows via CRM/API sync (HubSpot sync to CRM records), and a Zapier integration explicitly advertising 8,000+ app connections to automate post-meeting workflows, plus an open API/MCP for custom integrations. This directly matches the story's request for notes flowing into Slack, Notion-like tools, and thousands of apps via Zapier. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of a native Notion integration (only general 'apps' via Zapier/API), and no independent/hands-on verification of these integrations working in practice beyond vendor docs.
